title: Elegant Fluffy Sardinian Bonito Pinsa
description: A tangy and fluffy Sardinian dish featuring caramel and bonito shave, perfect for a sick day, served in a cazuela and formed as a pinsa, following a keto-friendly diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, bonito flakes, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and olive oil.
Add the egg mixture to the almond flour mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough into a thin sheet and cut into pinsa shapes.
Place the pinsa shapes in a cazuela and top with sugar free tomato sauce, caramel sauce, and grana padano cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
